item.title: Extractor Approved In Native Risk Collective As Risk Mitigation Expert
item.content:encoded:
**Hacken is proud to announce that Extractor has joined the [Native Risk Collective](https://www.native.inc/partnerships/risk-collective) — a first-of-its-kind insurance partnership and framework that rewards strong security practices. Recognised as a technical risk mitigation expert, Extractor is now an approved solution for reducing Cyber, Crime, and Technology Errors & Omissions (Tech E&O) risks in the digital asset space.**
![Extractor x Native](https://cdn.prod.website-files.com/67335565a20877e02cbe3629/688359da198a9147f2bbf495_extractor%20x%20native.jpg)
## About Native
[Native](https://www.native.inc/) is a global insurance broker for digital assets and crypto businesses. Native helps crypto-native teams and regulated institutions access insurance products designed for the decentralised economy. From fully regulated cover to entirely onchain options.
## The Importance of Joining Native Risk Collective
The **Native Risk Collective** is a pioneering partnership between **Native**, leading crypto security tools, and Lloyd's of London underwriters — designed to reward proactive risk management. Through this framework, companies using recognised risk mitigation tools like Extractor may access:
* **Premium discounts** on Crime, Cyber, and Tech E&O insurance * **Stronger underwriting outcomes** through reduced exposure * **Access to exclusive insurance products** tailored for digital asset operations
Please note: Hacken is not an insurance provider or broker. For insurance-specific inquiries, eligibility, or programme participation, please contact **Native Broking** directly.
## Backed by Lloyd's of London Underwriters
Extractor's risk mitigation capabilities have been independently assessed and **recognised by underwriters in the Lloyd's of London insurance market**. This assessment confirms the measurable impact our technology has on reducing cyber and infrastructure-related risks for digital asset companies
### Earning Our Place Among Trusted Experts
Extractor now joins the ranks of other **approved technical risk mitigation experts** in the Native Risk Collective, including:
* **Circuit** – Disaster recovery and key management * **BreachBits** – Ethical hacking and threat simulation * **Hypernative** – Onchain threat detection and automated response * **Station70** – Security for institutional and individual crypto investors
## What Sets Extractor Apart
[Extractor](https://www.extractor.live/) is an **all-in-one threat detection, prevention, and mitigation system** for Web3 projects, delivering real-time asset protection.
Purpose-built for blockchain-native teams by Hacken, Extractor combines the power of a next-generation **SIEM** (Security Information and Event Management) with **SOAR** (Security Orchestration, Automation, and Response) to proactively identify and neutralize crypto-specific threats before they escalate.
Key features include:
* **Transaction Firewall** to block malicious activity before it reaches assets * **No-code automation** to pause vulnerable contracts and block suspicious activity in real time * **Cross-chain monitoring** across 20+ blockchain networks * **Integrated compliance tools** to support AML/CFT adherence and audit readiness
With over 60 advanced threat detectors and a proven track record in preventing attacks, Extractor delivers measurable, regulator-recognised protection to some of the most complex blockchain ecosystems.
## Raising the Bar for Web3 Security
Extractor's inclusion in the Native Risk Collective reflects a broader shift in the industry — where **risk mitigation excellence is directly rewarded through better insurance terms and deeper trust** from regulators, institutions, and investors.
Together with Native and other approved security partners, Hacken is committed to:
* Making **security a competitive advantage** * Enabling **institutional confidence** in digital assets * Reducing the **total cost of risk** for Web3 builders
By bridging technical innovation with traditional safeguards, we're helping to shape a safer, more resilient digital asset ecosystem.
